title: Ingress SLO decomposer and spillback orchestration dashboard for token-level SLIs
creator: Daniel Kim
description:
Goal: Build a consolidated Grafana/Console dashboard and observability plumbing that decomposes ingress SLOs down to token-level SLIs and ties those signals to multi-region spillback and circuit-breaker state. This ticket covers: (1) instrumentation of token-granular latency and admission metadata in the decode path, (2) queries and panels that decompose SLO violations by region, model variant, shard, and admission path, (3) a spillback/spiral visualization that shows upstream admissions and downstream circuit transitions, and (4) alerting + runbook hooks for progressive load-shedding incidents.

Scope:
- Add token-level labels to existing latency histograms: region, model_name, model_shard, admission_path, request_priority. Token-level aggregation should be usable for p50/p95/p99 and tail-attribution traces.
- Create an "Ingress SLO Decomposer" dashboard with panels: token SLI time-series (p50/p95/p99), admission-path heatmap (latency & kv-cache-hit rate), regional spillback timeline (circuit state vs admit rate), top contributors to SLO gaps (by customer, prompt-prefix, model), and decode-path waterfall for sampled requests.
- Implement backend query templates (Prometheus/ClickHouse) and example Grafana variables for quick pivoting.
- Wire alerts to PagerDuty for: token-p99 regression (relative or absolute), regional circuit saturation, and sudden increase in admission rejections. Alerts include links to the decomposer view and the runbook.
- Add synthetic workload harness to generate prefix-skewed traffic for testing failover and spillback scenarios (configurable sequence lengths and priority mix).

Rationale: Current SLO visibility is top-level and mixes admission and decode latency. Teams need a single-pane-of-glass to answer questions like: "Which region/model/admit-path is responsible for a p99 spike?" and "Did a regional circuit trip before or after the KV cache miss surge?" This dashboard drives faster mitigation and better canary decisions for multi-region failover flows.

Non-goals: Full control-plane automation of spillback policies (this ticket is observability + runbook first). On-prem private deployment instrumentation variations will be a follow-up (separate ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Token-level latency metrics emitted with labels: region, model_name, model_shard, admission_path, request_priority
Grafana dashboard published: Ingress SLO Decomposer with panels for p50/p95/p99, admission-path heatmap, regional spillback timeline, top SLO contributors, and sampled decode waterfalls
Prometheus/ClickHouse query templates added to repo and documented in the dashboard JSON
PagerDuty alerts configured with clear thresholds and links to runbook and dashboard
Synthetic traffic harness deployed to staging and results documented in test run (failover and spillback scenarios)
